notes: Tidy up Fire TV (Settings › Fire TV): choose the Amazon extras you don't use, like shopping, promotions, tutorials and viewing recognition, and the one-time computer step switches them off. Nothing is uninstalled, and each can be switched back on
Switch off Amazon's own screensaver, the one with ads, right from Tidy up Fire TV
The Music button on the bottom bar is an icon like the others; its name shows when you highlight it
